name: intro
text: When you open a pytest-gremlins report, it comes up dark by default. No settings, no config — just dark, with the gremlin-green scores standing out right away.

name: dark_mode
text: Here it is at full width. The mutation scores are front and center, styled so you can read the results fast, even after a long test run.

name: toggle
text: Up in the corner there's a theme toggle. One click and you're in light mode.

name: persist
text: Now reload the page. It comes back in light mode — no flash, no reset. The preference is saved in local storage.

name: mobile
text: At 375 pixels — phone width — everything stacks cleanly. You can scroll vertically. No horizontal overflow.

name: outro
text: Dark by default, one-click toggle, and it remembers your choice. It also just works on a phone. Small things, but they're the difference between a report you actually check and one you ignore.
